<MethodEndpoint
  method={"put"}
  path={"/products/{sku}/classification"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Registers or replaces the handling classification for a SKU — SKU-level master data this service owns as source of truth (see ADR 0009), independent of any StockUnit or bin. Idempotent by SKU: classifying an already-classified SKU replaces its prior classification (a legitimate operational action, e.g. an item newly designated hazmat) rather than erroring. handlingTags must be a non-empty, duplicate-free array drawn from the closed enum; when (and only when) handlingTags includes TemperatureSensitive, temperatureClass is required. This classification is consulted by StowStock to enforce hazmat/temperature placement rules at stow time.
